w: Pramukh Swami Maharaj was doing his morning puja. Youths from the surrounding villages sang kirtans. Finally came the turn of little Harshad of Navagam. He was to give a speech. The topic was "TV". Before his speech was finished, Swamishri's puja was completed. Devotees began coming for Swamishri's darshan. Seeing the spoiler, Harshad was upset. Swamishri sensed his distress. Stopping the devotees, he said, "Finish your speech." And Harshad was overjoyed. He finished his speech. Swamishri listened to him lovingly, appreciating him with gestures of his hand. At the end of the speech, Swamishri called him close, lovingly placed his hand on his head and gave him prasad. He was utterly delighted. Will Harshad ever forget this loving image of Swamishri overflowing with compassion!?

In the evening assembly Swamishri said, "..There is no reason to believe that money alone brings happiness. One who is rich has many dangers to face. They get kidnapped, while no one kidnaps a poor man sleeping on the street. The point is that even the rich are unhappy and that is why Tulsidas says happiness lies in God and His holy sadhu..."

Swamishri performed the murti-pratishtha of Akshar Purushottam Maharaj, Radha Krishna Dev, Ganapatiji, Hanumanji and Guru Prarampara at the newly constructed Hari-mandir in Satellite - a suburb of Amdavad. Swamishri also blessed the assembly and Lord Harikrishna Maharaj was honored by the devotees.
At 7.15 p.m., Swamishri arrived in Kosindra and performed pujan and arti of Thakorji. The mandir hall was filled with devotees. Swamishri blessed the assembly.

At 8.00 p.m., Swamishri arrived at Bodeli and had Thakorji's darshan at the hari mandir. Today, Swamishri traveled 173 km in 3½ hr. Despite the long traveling and fatigue, Swamishri blessed the devotees in Bodeli.

Through the inspiration of Swamishri the construction of a grand BAPS shikharbaddh mandir is underway. At 5.15 p.m., Swamishri guided and placed the first carved stone pillar on the mandir plinth with the aid of the control panel of a large crane. Prior to this Swamishri and senior sadhus had performed the pujan rituals. Thereafter, in conclusion, Swamishri performed the rituals of mantra pushpanjali and arti.

In the evening satsang assembly Viveksagar Swami continued his address on the story of the BAPS centenary. After a traditional dance by children a drama portraying Shastriji Maharaj in the eyes of dignitaries was performed. Finally, Swamishri blessed the devotees, “The shastras have prescribed, ‘There is no moksha without knowledge.’ We find that the means to moksha are austerity, charity, yagna, etc. If they are done selflessly, with no worldly desires, then one attains moksha.”

To please Bhagwan Swaminarayan and Guru Pramukh Swami Maharaj children, youths and senior devotees perform austerities, pilgrimages or other devotional means. The spiritual endeavors performed by the devotees during Swamishri's visit to the local centers are congratulatory and worthy of recognition. It also reflects Swamishri's divinity for inspiring such spiritual efforts in children, teenagers and devotees.
25 February 2007, Bhavnagar
Many devotees had pilgrimaged by foot from Tadaja region.
Narayanbhai Gosai of Gondal observed a liquid fast for 86 days.
28 February 2007, Bhavnagar
Twenty-seven devotees from various suburbs performed a total of 27,620 dandvats before Thakorji.
Bhavesh Rathod (11 years) observed an 86-hour liquid fast and Mehul Bhatt observed a 48-hour liquid fast.
At 5.00 p.m. Swamishri visited the Akshardham complex.

A phone call came from Bharatbhai Patel (of Bhavpura), who lives in New York. He told Pramukh Swami Maharaj, "I started the green card process in 1998. In between I took your blessings 18 times. Every time you said, 'Be patient, God will make everything good.' And just two days ago the green card arrived at home."
Pleased to hear this news, Swamishri said, "You were patient, so you are blessed. You had faith and trust in God, so the work has been done."

After the call ended, praising him again, Swamishri said to the sadhus, "How blessed is his patience! Even after taking blessings 18 times, no doubt came into his mind and his patience did not waver. His family's patience did not waver either, so Maharaj did the work."

ds.t: Eighteen blessings and a green card
w: A call came from Bharatbhai Patel (Bhavpura), who lives in New York. He told Swamishri, "I started the green card process in 1998. Along the way I took your blessings 18 times. Each time you said, 'Keep patience, God will make everything right.' And just two days ago the green card arrived at home."
Pleased to hear this news, Swamishri said, "You kept patience, so blessed are you. You had faith and trust in God, and so the work has been done."

After the call, Swamishri praised him again to the sadhus: "How blessed is his patience! He took blessings eighteen times and still no doubt came into his mind and his patience did not waver. His family's patience did not waver either, so Maharaj did the work."

After his puja was over, as Mahant Swami Maharaj was returning, on the way he was requested to stand among the volunteers of the security department for a group photo. Swamishri did stand, but immediately asked, "Thakorji?" Hariprakashdas Swami quickly brought Thakorji.
Taking Thakorji in his hands, Swamishri was pleased and said to him, "You did a very good job. Without Thakorji it felt dull."
"Muktanand says thus, Mohan is my all in all." For Swamishri, Thakorji is everything.

ds.p: On the flight from Delhi to Jalandhar
w: Three devotees had accepted to do a seva as Mahant Swami Maharaj had instructed. When Swamishri was travelling from Delhi to Jalandhar in a chartered plane, these devotees prayed to him, "We will do this seva as you instructed, but please make our Akshardham certain."
Swamishri said with spiritual joy, "I go about carrying Akshardham with me."

Granting Akshardham is the monopoly of Purushottam Narayan and Aksharbrahma. Swamishri himself is Aksharbrahma. That is why his words and his voice ring with a firm conviction of giving Akshardham, which brings a firm conviction to our hearts too.
